name: RecordedTest
summary: Is produced by recording what somebody did to the system, so that a test exists without anyone writing one.

roles.name: RecordedTest
roles.summary: A test captured rather than written. It is the cheapest test to obtain and the most expensive to keep: nothing in it says what it is about, so when it goes red the only way to learn what changed is to re-record it — which is why knowing a test is one matters more than for any other kind.
